Cc: Priyanka Singh <p.singh@orthoserve.health>

Subject: Draft reference for Orthoserve pilot — please review

Hi Mina + team,

Thanks again for partnering on the pilot. Attached is a fresh draft of the customer reference (orthoserve_case_draft_v3.docx) and the pilot results table (pilot_results_table.csv). We want to move this to publishing next week, but we need a quick pass from Redwood on a few points before we share publicly: 

- Accuracy of the two performance claims in the second paragraph ("45% reduction in tail latency" and "~35% lower inference cost"). Can you confirm those are the numbers you show from the pilot?
- A short quote from your engineering lead endorsing the integration — we expected something ~1 sentence.
- Permission to use the Orthoserve logo and our one-line product blurb in the header.
- Please review the paragraph that references "on-prem throughput tests" — can it be softened if necessary?

We'd like to capture any redlines as a PDF and get a signed approval (DocuSign link below) by Wednesday so our marketing team can schedule the publish for Friday.

DocuSign (preview): https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABC123-orthoserve

Attachments: orthoserve_case_draft_v3.docx, pilot_results_table.csv

Thanks,
Elena

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft reference for Orthoserve pilot — please review

Hi Elena — thanks for the draft and the clear checklist. Quick notes after an initial read (I attached a saved PDF of inline comments as redlines_orthoserve.pdf):

- Numbers: the pilot results CSV aligns with the claims but with slight nuance. Our internal aggregate shows 42% median latency reduction and a 31–34% inference cost reduction depending on batching configuration. The 45% figure is the best-case tail number for a very narrow test — if you want a clean public stat we recommend using "~42% median latency reduction" and "~32% lower inference cost".

- Quote: happy to provide one from our engineering lead. Aditya, can you share a 1-line quote that is customer-facing and approves the logo usage?

- On-prem paragraph: recommend replacing any absolute wording ("on-prem throughput" -> "on comparable on-prem hardware during validation tests") — will soften to avoid overgeneralization.

- Logo & blurb: legal will need a brief usage clause. Looping Grace for marketing/legal signoff.

If that sounds good, I can incorporate the edits and send back a tracked PDF for final signoff. We can also accept redlines in the Word doc if you prefer.

Attachments: redlines_orthoserve.pdf (inline comments)

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi all — quick legal/marketing pass below. I'm attaching a redlines PDF with suggested phrasing (see redlines_orthoserve.pdf). Highlights: 

- Suggested public performance stat: "Using Redwood Inference, Orthoserve reduced median inference latency by ~42% while lowering inference cost by ~32% during our validation pilot." That framing is accurate and conservative.

- Avoid absolute comparatives (we removed "best-in-class" language and replaced with "significant").

- Quote suggestion for Aditya (engineering): "Integrating Redwood Inference cut our median latency and lowered per-request costs, enabling us to scale production inference without sacrificing response time." (Aditya — feel free to edit for tone.)

- Logo usage: Orthoserve marketing is OK to display both logos with the standard 60-day review clause. We need a brief note in the DocuSign that Orthoserve approves use of the Redwood logo as well.

- Approvals: once Elena confirms the revised numbers and Aditya provides the line, Legal will sign off and we can proceed to DocuSign.

Attachments: redlines_orthoserve.pdf
